findings: The one-shot sealed run completed 24/24 fresh combat observations with 22 cap survivors, 2 player deaths, 0 failures, 0 omissions, 0 retries, and 0 not-run rows.

The native low-HP policy changed selection as intended: mean owner dealer-target share across the 12 baseline rows was 25.6%, versus 55.3% across low-HP rows. Champion formation target samples matched the owner selection 99.9-100% of the time when non-null.

Combat effectiveness was mixed: low-HP won 4 of 12 matched kill totals, baseline won 7, and 1 tied. Low-HP total kills were 696 versus 646 because it avoided the two baseline deaths; the median paired kill delta was -2, so this is not a universal throughput win.

Champion and Berserker supplied the strongest strategy-specific survival readbacks: Champion low-HP capped at 50 kills in both seeds while its 101021 baseline died at 42.9 seconds, and Berserker low-HP capped at 50 versus an 18-kill baseline death. These are fixture/package observations, not class-wide guarantees.

Cleanse was exercised in the raw guard streams: 367 baseline and 543 low-HP activations removed 285/410 sampled slow effects and 137/222 sundered effects respectively. Position/control streams remain descriptive; no causal movement, healing, summon damage, economy, or population claim is made.

decisionsOrQuestions.decision: Keep the formation inheritance fix canonical in the measured source and accept native-owner-target-inheritance as a strategy reference for Champion; do not treat it as a stat buff or deployment approval.
Leave all six packages and coefficients unchanged. Do not add Endure, a new kiting arm, a coefficient change, or another rescue run from this packet.
